label: 4K PoE bullet IP camera
description: 8 MP (4K) bullet camera with smart person/vehicle detection and 30 m IR, single RJ45 10/100 port. Powered by PoE 802.3af, 12 W max, and it has no Wi-Fi radio.
notes: PoE class 802.3af, 12.95 W at the PSE, 12 W drawn - right at the class limit, so it will brown out on a marginal injector. Wired only, no 12 VDC jack on the PoE SKU. No ONVIF-profile-S-only caveat: fully ONVIF compliant.
